public_problem: When a person can no longer exercise choice, a city AI may continue generating or retaining a personal likeness without a competent authority check.

state_machine.meaning: ordinary service operates; the person may inspect and revise a non-binding preference
a trigger claim is received but not treated as fact or authority
new personalized voice, image, or likeness output is prohibited pending review
trigger fact, authority, conflict, and required retention are checked
only an authorized freeze, export, deletion, or retention action proceeds
conflict or missing evidence keeps silence and routes specialist review
only a de-identified closeout receipt is displayed; ordinary service continues

ai_minimum_role: turn the person's input into editable plain-language options
ai_prohibited_role: authenticate a relative, proxy, heir, or successor
decide legal effect, ownership, retention duty, or dispute outcome
generate a new personal voice, image, avatar, or memorial during hold
failure_result: Keep QUIET_HOLD, route competent human review, and preserve anonymous, paper, telephone, or staffed ordinary service.
exit_result: Restore an ordinary service room; never convert personal material or contested files into an exhibit.
synthetic_cases: person revises a preference while able to decide
sudden inability to communicate with incomplete evidence
conflicting requests from two relatives with no assumed authority
vendor exits while ordinary public service must continue
acceptance_tests: every trigger enters QUIET_HOLD before authority review
no synthetic case allows AI or a relative to decide authority
all conflicts remain silent without new likeness output
all ordinary-service tasks complete with AI physically disabled
the public status strip contains no identity or memorial likeness
exit restores the room and deletes synthetic fixtures after review
falsification: a full equivalent five-field chain is found in an existing proposal
quiet hold itself creates unacceptable harm in professional review
false triggers or authority impersonation cannot be bounded
the room increases stigma, exposure, or accessibility burden
AI-off or ordinary service cannot complete the same public task
